newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.482 billion yuan from 2.004 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said daily turnover had been thin in the past few days with the state banks trading little on the market.

Market rumours said the central bank was recently probing state banks for possilbe illegal bank funds flowing into the stock markets after it issued a ban on the banks trading on the markets last week.
Central officials have declined to comment.
"State banks have greatly reduced their trading in the past few days, resulting in thin volume," one trader said.
Traders said they believed the interbank rates would move narrowly in slow trading in the next few days.
